title: Glimpse the Far Side of the Sun

entities.name: Huatli
entities.description: A Sun Empire warrior and planeswalker, trained as a future warrior-poet, who races Angrath to Orazca and confronts Saint Elenda.

entities.name: Inti
entities.description: Huatli's cousin, shown as a child defending her question.

entities.name: Angrath
entities.description: A minotaur planeswalker with chains, Huatli's brash ally, who wants to leave Ixalan to see his daughters.

entities.name: Saint Elenda
entities.description: A vampire saint, first of the Legion of Dusk's faith, who emerges from a tomb near Orazca and says her followers were meant to learn humility.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker regaining his memories, who recalls Ugin and a golden dragon and meets Azor.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A gorgon planeswalker and captain who accompanies Jace to Orazca.

entities.name: Azor
entities.description: A sphinx and former parun of the Azorius who guards the Immortal Sun's chamber in Orazca.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: An ancient spirit dragon who, in Jace's memory, sent him away with a hidden mental command.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker from Jace's past who never praised him.

entities.name: Alhammarret
entities.description: The sphinx who tampered with Jace's memory years before.

entities.name: Aclazotz
entities.description: A being named in the legend of the Bat of the East.

entities.name: Orazca
entities.description: The golden city that rises from the jungle, containing the Immortal Sun.

entities.name: Immortal Sun
entities.description: The relic in Orazca that groups believe does many different things.

entities.name: Thaumatic Compass
entities.description: The compass that points to the central tower.

entities.name: Tocatli
entities.description: A place in whose shadow Huatli's childhood sparring ground lay.

entities.name: Kaldheim
entities.description: A cold, snowy plane glimpsed through Angrath's portal.

entities.name: Ixalan
entities.description: The plane from which planeswalkers are blocked from leaving.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane of the Azorius.

entities.name: Torrezon
entities.description: The vampires' homeland named by Angrath as one of the ant groups.

entities.name: Sun Empire
entities.description: The dinosaur-riding empire Huatli serves.

entities.name: River Heralds
entities.description: The merfolk of Ixalan.

entities.name: Legion of Dusk
entities.description: The vampire army and church of the conquistadors.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The Ravnican guild whose symbol marks the Orazca door.

events.summary: As an eight-year-old, Huatli asks a priest what is on the far side of the sun and is told it doesn't matter (flashback).
events.quote: What's on the far side of the sun?

events.summary: The priest explains the duty of a warrior-poet to tell others' truths (flashback).
events.quote: It means that when you tell stories, you are telling someone's truth.

events.summary: Huatli and Angrath watch Orazca rise from the valley.
events.quote: They watched as the golden spires of Orazca climbed higher and higher above the canopy of the valley below.

events.summary: Huatli finds the real city unlike the one in her vision.
events.quote: The city was more beautiful than she could possibly have imagined . . . and it looked nothing like the city she had seen in her vision.

events.summary: Huatli tells Angrath her emperor sent her to find Orazca.
events.quote: My emperor tasked me with this.

events.summary: Angrath calls every group on Ixalan ants on an anthill.
events.quote: The Sun Empire are ants on an anthill, and so are the River Heralds and so is Torrezon and so is every other group of idiots on this plane.

events.summary: Angrath leads Huatli into the Blind Eternities-like space between planes by planeswalking.
events.quote: Her perception wavered, and she leaned forward into a separate realm.

events.summary: Huatli looks through Angrath's portal at a snowy mountain plane and is yanked back by the barrier.
events.quote: Huatli tore through space and color and back through the fabric of existence

events.summary: Angrath names the plane they saw as Kaldheim and explains freedom starts with knowing you are trapped.
events.quote: Kaldheim,

events.summary: Angrath says they must be near whatever keeps them locked on the plane.
events.quote: We must be near whatever is keeping us locked on this plane,

events.summary: Angrath reveals he wants to see his daughters, whom he has not seen in fourteen years.
events.quote: I want to see my daughters

events.summary: Huatli and Angrath find a bat-marked tomb near Orazca and Huatli recalls the legend of the Bat of the East.
events.quote: There's a legend that says the bat of the East met Aclazotz

events.summary: A pale hand slides the tomb door aside and Saint Elenda emerges.
events.quote: a pale white hand reached out from the interior.

events.summary: Angrath identifies the vampire as Saint Elenda.
events.quote: You are Saint Elenda,

events.summary: Saint Elenda says Orazca has awoken at last.
events.quote: Orazca has awoken at last.

events.summary: Huatli threatens Elenda, refusing to let the Legion of Dusk take the city.
events.quote: I refuse to allow the Legion of Dusk to take the city.

events.summary: Elenda says she came only to retrieve what was hers and leave the rest in peace.
events.quote: To retrieve the one thing that is ours,

events.summary: Elenda laments that the Church turned her ritual into invasion.
events.quote: I left the Church with the knowledge of the ritual to take on my burden

events.summary: Saint Elenda vows to teach the Legion of Dusk what they forgot and vanishes through a dark slice in the air.
events.quote: She stepped forward, past Huatli and Angrath, and vanished into a dark slice in the air.

events.summary: Angrath attacks Huatli with a chain, then runs ahead to Orazca.
events.quote: Angrath launched a chain at Huatli's face that she just barely dodged, its heat searing her cheek.

events.summary: Huatli resolves to beat Angrath to Orazca.
events.quote: was going to get there before she did.

events.summary: Jace climbs the golden stairs to Orazca, exhausted and in control of his memories.
events.quote: He deliberately placed each foot ahead of the other as he ascended the stairs to Orazca

events.summary: Jace recalls trying to break into a golden dragon's mind and his own being erased (memory).
events.quote: He was trying to break into a dragon's mind.

events.summary: Jace recalls Ugin bidding him farewell (memory).
events.quote: Good fortune, Jace Beleren

events.summary: Jace realizes the memory of Ugin hides a spell that compelled him to planeswalk to Ixalan.
events.quote: a clever bit of obfuscating mental magic that the spirit dragon must have implanted without him noticing.

events.summary: Vraska checks the compass at the top of the stairs.
events.quote: What we need is in there.

events.summary: A huge flying creature rises over Orazca while Jace hides them with an illusion.
events.quote: An immense dinosaur's head towered over the city.

events.summary: Jace realizes his earnest self on Ixalan is who he always was.
events.quote: That was who he had always been. He had just forgotten.

events.summary: Jace remembers his mother and hopes she is alive.
events.quote: He liked being able to remember his mother.

events.summary: Jace tells Vraska he recalls the skills his mentor taught him.
events.quote: I can remember the skills my mentor taught me, now.

events.summary: Jace reflects that Liliana never called him incredible, unlike Vraska.
events.quote: Liliana never told Jace he was incredible.

events.summary: Jace solves the maze on the tower's back door.
events.quote: Jace started to trace the solution to the maze, a line of blue magically trailing his fingers as they moved.

events.summary: Jace realizes the door bears the Azorius symbol that appears when they try to planeswalk.
events.quote: It's the symbol of the Azorius.

events.summary: Jace senses a sphinx's mind inside the room.
events.quote: This person's mind was familiar, labyrinthine, a mind like only one he had ever encountered before.

events.summary: Vraska promises telepathically that no sphinx will hurt Jace again.
events.quote: You'll never be hurt by a sphinx ever again,

events.summary: The sphinx in the throne room announces himself as Azor and threatens Vraska.
events.quote: I am Azor, the Lawbringer,

events.summary: Jace shields Vraska's mind from Azor.
events.quote: Jace slammed a psychic ward between the sphinx and Vraska.

events.summary: Jace declares himself the Living Guildpact and Azor recoils, calling him the fail-safe.
events.quote: I am Jace Beleren, the Living Guildpact,

relations.note: An uneasy alliance to reach Orazca.
Close companions who climb to Orazca together.
relations.quote: You're incredible. You know that, right?

relations.note: Azor was parun of the Azorius.
relations.quote: The parun of the Azorius was Azor.
And you will be a prisoner for the third time in your life, gorgon

relations.note: Ugin hid a memory trap in Jace's mind that sent him to Ixalan.
relations.quote: a clever bit of obfuscating mental magic that the spirit dragon must have implanted without him noticing.
the same care he had when Alhammarret had meddled with his memory years before
